# Continual-ARC puzzle solving

Use this procedure when handling a puzzle in a Continual-ARC stream.

Preserve demos as received; never use a sparse reconstruction or hand-derived expected output, since transcription errors can masquerade as rule failures. If transcribing a grid for execution, check its row and column counts against the stated header before using its output. Before submission, check that the returned grid has 1–30 nonempty rows of equal length, with only integer cell values 0–9; output dimensions need not equal the input dimensions.
